text: EntropIA stores corpus SQLite database. entropiaR package tidy, typed interface database — v1 read-construction. entropia_connect() opens file SQLite’s read-flags re-asserts PRAGMA query_only = , nothing package can ever modify database. deliberate: database may live EntropIA desktop app (WAL journal, sync engine, 81 triggers guard schema), read-client safe point time.

title: Exploring the corpus
text: EntropIA organizes research material three-level hierarchy: collection research project folder (e.g. “Conflicto SOIP 1965-66”); item one document inside collection (newspaper page, letter, photo); asset one physical file belonging item — image, PDF, audio recording. PDF item usually one asset per page; PDF page assets point parent asset via parent_asset_id carry page_number. Everything else hangs spine: text layers (extractions, transcriptions, layouts), entities triples, notes annotations, topics, LLM results, RAG artifacts.
code: collections ──→ items ──→ assets

title: entropiaR 0.0.0.9001 (development)
text: Temporal bucketing floors pre-epoch instants containing second/minute/hour instead rounding toward zero, every unit now returns typed empty result zero rows (week longer errors). entropia_collect() infers types structurally dbplyr’s query tree (base tables, projections, rename aliases); transformed expressions merely reuse manifest name stay raw, explicit schema = mapping validated joins. old whole-SQL regex inference gone. Collection identity: entropia_compare_collections() groups collection_id (labels retained), quality/overview tables carry group_id -named collections never merge. entropia_metadata() tolerates non-scalar __entropia_file_metadata fields, keeps raw JSON collided keys, reports per-row diagnostics instead aborting whole parse. Schema compatibility now requires core collections/items/assets tables every version, empty foreign SQLite file can longer report compatible = TRUE default policy. CSV/TSV export writes real UTF-8 bytes locale (single binary connection, enc2utf8() + useBytes), lazy exports complete total order across projected columns instead trusting first two. entropia_schema_info() reports live presence SQLite type next expected manifest contract, generated VIRTUAL columns longer hidden introspection. entropia_connect() validates arguments policy opening guarantees disconnect every post-open failure.

title: entropiaR 0.0.0.9001 (development)
text: Provenance separates structural identity (schema_hash), source identity (snapshot_sha256, self-contained file without live WAL) data identity (dataset_sha256, canonical digest collected result), plus resolved SQL full selection recipe captured values. Reading provenance derived object re-computes digest, reports scope = "derived" preserves origin digest/SQL — origin query never claimed reproduce transformed rows. entropia_write_provenance() accepts redact = TRUE strip source paths origin query shareable sidecars. entropia_analysis_dataset() supports unit = "item"|"asset", column projection, explicit text policy shared selection parameters (collections id, asset types, pages, study date inclusive range).

title: entropiaR 0.0.0.9001 (development)
text: entropia_overview() aggregates whole study universe SQLite returns counts, per-collection rows, asset types, monthly temporal profile exclusion counts, quality eligibility/no_data/not_applicable statuses, entity/topic occurrence distinct-item prevalence, schema inventory exact selection. corpus text BLOB collected. entropia_profile() profiles collected tibbles locally: structure, missingness, numeric statistics, categorical distributions, exact-duplicate key-duplicate counts, opt-reproducible sampling leaves caller’s RNG untouched. entropia_reconstruct_analysis() resolves LLM targets batched lookups per unique target instead one query per row; targets documented current context, never historical model input.

title: entropiaR 0.0.0.9001 (development)
text: Grouped temporal plots longer draw one line across groups; entity bars never stack -named values different groups, explicit group/facet/top_by controls distinct-ID labels. New families: topics, missingness, collections, distributions (histogram/ECDF/boxplot optional log scale), scatter correlation heatmaps (numeric columns , ID-like names excluded). Empty selections render annotated -data states instead silently dropping rows.

title: entropiaR 0.0.0.9001 (development)
text: entropia_dashboard(path) builds shiny.appobj snapshot: one read-connection per session pinned one read transaction, shared applied selection across summary/quality/exploration/detail/export panels, server-side pagination, -demand text, bounded downloads redacted provenance, explicit caveats (operational dates document dates; AI-extracted entities verified facts). Shiny/bslib stay Suggests. entropia_report() renders overview tables frozen Quarto dashboard optional redaction paths identifying labels; never re-queries database browser. Connection & administration: entropia_connect() (read-, schema compatibility policy, S3/S4 typed connection), entropia_disconnect(), entropia_copy() (WAL-aware snapshot), entropia_status(), entropia_validate(), entropia_schema_version(), entropia_schema_info(), entropia_schema_compat(). Entity access: one lazy tbl_sql accessor per readable table (entropia_items(), entropia_assets(), entropia_entities(), entropia_chunks(), …) column contract applied entropia_collect() (millisecond timestamps → POSIXct, JSON--TEXT → list-columns, embedding BLOBs opt-). Search: entropia_search() — parameter-safe FTS5 search items chunk indexes. Domain layer: entropia_corpus(), entropia_text(), entropia_metadata(), OCR/metadata coverage helpers, entropia_corpus_quality(), entropia_orphans(). Research layer: entropia_entity_relations(), entropia_reconstruct_analysis(), entropia_conversation(). Sync metadata: entropia_sync_info() (whitelisted sync_meta keys typed R types, never raw app_settings secrets), entropia_sync_versions(), entropia_conflicts() (reason enum documented). Analysis & visualization: temporal/entity/topic/collection helpers, reproducible entropia_analysis_dataset() provenance, ggplot2 helpers. Write API: v1 stubs (entropia_insert/update/upsert/delete) error clear v2 guidance. Lifecycle & messages: analysis layer carries experimental lifecycle badge; deprecation policy (lifecycle::deprecate_warn(), one-release grace) documented package help. Every exported error warning cli-formatted stable condition class — including new entropia_warn_malformed_json class tolerant JSON reads — bare stop()/warning() remains R/. Performance: corpus, FTS search, entity-relations joins resolve every lookup table index (EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN verified); smoke test enforces corpus join never full-scans joined table.
